Name: Kedi's Desert Festival Dish Retexture
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=3]Soo, Vanilla Desert Festival foods also seemed very low effort(a couple are cardboards, even) so I wanted to try resprite them to give them better looks. Enjoy! 

Features
[list]
[*]New looks for all desert festival foods
[*]Configs for every one of them, so you can disable certain ones if you don't like them or prefer another mod.
[/list][/size]
[size=3]Let me know in the comments if you have any suggestions, and endorse it if you like it![/size]
